reader.notes: BindOpen returns BoundImplicitSeries.Of one BoundOpen per file-name in source order, and EmitOpen emits for each its open, status store and USE hook. Probed with mixed organizations and a USE that returns: order and per-file modes are as the rule says.

refuter.evidence: Probe r17.cob (class b, the same file-name twice in one OPEN, in one mode group and across two): OPEN OUTPUT F G F gave F 41 (third open of an open file), G 00, and the later WRITE on F 00 (the first open stood); OPEN INPUT F I-O F G gave F 41 from its I-O and kept INPUT mode (WRITE 48), G opened I-O 00. These are the results of separate OPENs in source order. cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR17 'as if a separate OPEN statement had been written for each file-name'.
